title: evidence-nde (v2.8)
description: Non-Delivery Evidence. Issued by RDP(out) or RDP(in) when a message cannot be delivered or accepted within policy windows.

event.description: ETSI EN 319 522-1 clause 6 event (component G03) for the non-delivery. See Annex I for the reason-to-event mapping.

reason.description: Normative reason codes (extendable in future versions). no-matching-scope: submission refused because no confidentiality scope matches the content class and no fallback is declared (D4). scope-violation: the message's content class is not permitted by the group's scope descriptor (D5). duplicate-message-id: a submission reuses a message_id already accepted for a different recipient or payload (A.2; the I-D Error Handling and Retries). keypackage-pool-exhausted: first contact could not proceed because the recipient's single-use KeyPackage pool is depleted (A.2; a registry action, finding R7 / wallet H) — distinct from recipient-unreachable, so pool exhaustion is attributable rather than silent. X-25: the value space is REGISTRY-GOVERNED, not spec-versioned — the schema bounds only the LEXICAL form (lowercase-kebab; x- = private use, never registered). The registered set and its event bindings live in registries/reason-codes.json (umbrella §13.4); registering a code is a registry action, NOT a version bump (§9.3). An unregistered well-formed code is accepted, preserved verbatim and treated generically (LINT-NDE-W1).

payload_hash.description: The APPLICATION-CONTENT commitment (F-14 hash-domain rule): the sender-declared digest of the plaintext content of an ACCEPTED message. REQUIRED on every post-acceptance NDE (B.3/C.5/D.2/E.2 events); FORBIDDEN on an intake-stage A.2 NDE, which carries submission_hash instead — the two domains are distinct fields and are NEVER compared.

recipient_confirmation.description: Present when reason is 'payload-hash-mismatch': the recipient's signed/session-authenticated mismatch confirmation (the I-D (Canonicalisation and Payload Hashing), R11).

redirect_uid.description: Present when reason is 'uid-merged'. Points to the surviving entity's UID.

submission_hash.description: F-14 (evidence 2.6): the REJECTED-SUBMISSION commitment — SHA-256 over the EXACT submitted octets as received at the intake boundary, BEFORE any parsing or decoding (the posted request body bytes). REQUIRED on an intake-stage A.2-SubmissionRejection NDE (the envelope was never accepted, possibly never parsed); FORBIDDEN elsewhere. A submission_hash and a payload_hash live in different semantic domains and are NEVER compared.

allOf.$comment: N3/LINT-NDE-07: NDE reason binds to its EN 319 522-1 event (TS clause 8.1).
